title: Stop committing compiled platform binaries to git -- build and publish from CI-qualified artifacts (supersedes QCLI-135)
description:
User decision, 2026-09-13, made via the orchestrator with the QCLI-135 trade-off stated explicitly (immutable human-inspectable git-committed artifact vs. a CI-built qualified artifact carried forward as a workflow artifact): converge npm/*/bin/ packaging on lore-cli's shape. Do not commit compiled platform binaries (npm/quest-*/bin/quest[.exe]) to git going forward. This is a deliberate supersession of QCLI-135's conclusion (which was correct when made, on 2026-08-30, under the constraints then understood), not a correction of it -- QCLI-135 stays Done and unedited; see its own added note recording the supersession.

Reference shape (this fleet's own working example, not a design to invent from scratch): lore-cli's .github/workflows/release.yml. Its `package-qualification` matrix job builds+packs+installs+smokes+audits each platform natively on its own runner, uploads the qualified tarball as a workflow artifact, and its `package` job re-verifies the tarball's sha256 against the qualification report before assembling dist-npm/ -- publish never re-reads a git-committed binary and never rebuilds between qualification and publish. lore-cli's npm/*/bin/ is gitignored; only npm/<platform>/package.json templates are committed.

quest-cli already has half of this pattern: .github/workflows/prepublication-qualification.yml's `immutable-candidates` job builds fresh per-platform (`bun run build:packages`) on non-release dispatches and uploads each as a `quest-package-<target>` artifact; its `candidate-bundle` job already downloads and reassembles those artifacts (see its chmod/executable-bit-restoration step, needed because artifact upload does not preserve file mode). What's missing is a path from a qualified artifact to `release.yml`'s `publish` job -- today that job's `npm publish` runs from a git checkout at the release tag, reading whatever is committed in npm/quest-<target>/bin/.

Constraints carried over from QCLI-135/QCLI-267 that the new shape must still satisfy, not relax:
- Bun's --compile output is not byte-reproducible. Whatever gets published must be the EXACT bytes that were qualified (native-execution receipt) -- never a fresh rebuild at publish time. lore-cli satisfies this by never rebuilding between its qualification and package jobs, only ever carrying the same artifact forward; the new quest-cli shape must do the same (carry `prepublication-qualification.yml`'s per-target build artifact through to `release.yml`'s publish job, not re-invoke `bun run build:packages` in the publish workflow).
- QCLI-267's release-provenance gate (scripts/qualification/release-provenance.mjs) checks the registry's gitHead against the SOURCE commit that was tagged/released -- this is about git HEAD identity, not file provenance, so it is unaffected by binaries no longer being tracked, but re-verify this explicitly rather than assuming.
- The native-execution receipt / --verify-committed path in prepublication-qualification.yml's immutable-candidates job is written around "the committed artifact is the thing being published" -- this needs to become "the qualified artifact from this run is the thing being published," which changes what --verify-committed verifies against (or replaces it with an artifact-identity check, mirroring lore-cli's sha256-against-qualification-report check in its `package` job).
- docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md documents the current procedure and will need updating to match.

Sequencing: this task is scoped and reviewed independently. It does not ride the chore/QCLI-271-release-0.6.1 branch, and QCLI-271's SIGKILL root-cause investigation proceeds independently -- the two may turn out to converge (once binaries are no longer tracked, the git operation that triggers the SIGKILL may simply never run again), but that would be a side effect to verify afterward, not a substitute for root-causing QCLI-271's blocker on its own.

The actual `npm publish` step remains in the fleet's irreversible set regardless of pipeline shape and goes to the user directly, never to an orchestrator.

acceptanceCriteria.text: npm/quest-*/bin/quest[.exe] are gitignored (npm/*/bin/, matching lore-cli), and are not present in any new commit going forward

release.yml publish job installs/publishes from a workflow artifact produced by prepublication-qualification.yml, not from a git checkout of committed binaries, and never re-invokes a build step between qualification and publish

The published bytes for each platform are provably the exact bytes the native-execution receipt qualified (an explicit identity check, e.g. sha256 comparison, mirroring lore-cli's package job), not merely bytes built from the same source commit
QCLI-267's release-provenance --pre/--post gates still pass unmodified in meaning (gitHead == released commit), re-verified against the new pipeline rather than assumed unaffected
docs/runbooks/quest-cli-package-and-release.md is updated to describe the new build-in-CI, never-commit procedure
QCLI-135 itself is left Done and unedited; the supersession is recorded as an added note on QCLI-135 referencing this task, date, and reason
